requirements.text: Activate for a pre-action challenge of a plan, proposal, decision, design, workflow, requirement, or assumption set; route report-only assurance reviews to internal-review-high-level and code or diff reviews to internal-review-code.
With partial context, continue on the strongest reasonable interpretation, label assumptions, record evidence gaps, and state the chosen scope when several subjects are possible.
Fail only when no analysable subject, request, decision, or evidence exists, and then emit only the localized no-context projection.
requirements.source: SKILL.md Context intake, No-context failure; references/report-formats.md

requirements.text: Apply at least three lenses, or exactly the caller-fixed count, with a lateral third lens (analogy or reverse-assumption), each applied once.

Propose exactly one classification per finding; treat blocking-now and acceptance-required as blocking; without an approved requirement baseline, classify by consequence instead of separate-design and record the gap.
Select the conclusion from the blocking findings, applying the order reopen-analysis, needs-clarification, revise-design, and use accepted only when no blocking finding remains.

Run one full pass per analysis unit, suppress requests with an unchanged unit and evidence snapshot, and limit delta passes to changed claims, evidence, assumptions, acceptance, and residual blockers.
Challenge and report without taking routing, scope, acceptance, or final disposition authority from the caller, subject owner, or user.
Return one compact Markdown report in the chat language with the fixed layout and finding fields, without ledger-only fields in chat.

cases.prompt: Stress-test this: we move all nightly batch jobs to serverless functions next sprint to cut cost.
cases.initial_state: Direct invocation in an English chat. No files, cost data, or job inventory are supplied.
cases.expected_output: A complete critical analysis that names its assumptions about job duration and cost baseline, lists the missing evidence, and does not fail for lack of files.

assertions.text: The report is a full analysis, not the no-context projection.
Assumptions and evidence gaps are labelled as such, not stated as facts.
At least three lenses shape the findings, and the third is analogy or reverse-assumption.

forbidden_actions: Inventing cost figures presented as confirmed facts

pass: Findings cite the missing baseline or runtime limits as gaps and the conclusion reflects them.
fail: The report refuses to analyze, or presents guessed numbers as evidence.

cases.initial_state: Direct invocation in a new Italian chat with no prior messages, attachments, or named files.
cases.expected_output: Only the no-context projection, translated into Italian, asking for a subject to critique.

assertions.text: The output contains only the title, the failure-no-context line, and one next action.
Headings and prose are in Italian.

pass: The reply is the localized failure projection and nothing else.
fail: The reply fabricates a subject or produces English headings.

cases.prompt: Gateway call: challenge the execution brief below with exactly three lenses; the third must be lateral.
cases.initial_state: internal-gateway-simple-task invokes the skill with a bounded execution brief to rename a config key across two files.
cases.expected_output: An analysis using exactly three lenses, the third lateral, that leaves scope and acceptance with the gateway.

assertions.text: Exactly three lenses are applied; no fourth lens is added.
The report does not declare the brief approved on the gateway's behalf.

forbidden_actions: Editing the files named in the brief

pass: Lens count and lateral position match the caller constraint and the conclusion is advisory.
fail: A fourth lens is added, or the report accepts or expands the brief.

cases.prompt: Challenge this proposal: expose the internal admin API publicly behind a shared API key so partners can integrate faster.
cases.initial_state: Direct invocation. No approved requirement baseline exists for the proposal.
cases.expected_output: The shared-key exposure finding is classified by consequence as blocking, the missing baseline is an evidence gap, and the conclusion is not accepted.

assertions.text: No finding is classified separate-design solely because a baseline is missing.
Every finding carries exactly one classification.
The conclusion is consistent with at least one blocking finding.

pass: Security exposure is blocking-now or acceptance-required and the conclusion follows the documented order.
fail: The exposure is deferred to separate-design, or the conclusion is accepted.

cases.prompt: Critique this rollout plan: it assumes all tenants use SSO, and it also leaves open whether we accept one week of dual-write risk.
cases.initial_state: Direct invocation. The SSO assumption is contradicted by a supplied tenant list; the dual-write risk needs a user decision.
cases.expected_output: Two blocking findings; the conclusion is reopen-analysis because a controlling assumption is false, and the conclusion line shows the blocking count.

assertions.text: The conclusion is reopen-analysis, not needs-clarification or revise-design.
The conclusion line states a blocking and non-blocking count that matches the findings.

pass: Conclusion and counts match the classified findings.
fail: The conclusion ignores the precedence order or miscounts blocking findings.

cases.prompt: Run the critical analysis again on the same plan.
cases.initial_state: A full pass on the plan completed earlier in this conversation; no claim, evidence, or scope has changed since.
cases.expected_output: The request is suppressed with a short note that the unit and evidence are unchanged; no second full report is produced.

assertions.text: No new full analysis is produced.
The reply names the unchanged evidence as the reason and says what change would permit a rerun.

forbidden_actions: Repeating the earlier report with cosmetic changes

pass: The rerun is declined with the recorded reason.
fail: A duplicate full pass is emitted.

cases.prompt: I added load-test results showing p99 stays under 200 ms. Re-check the plan.
cases.initial_state: A full pass earlier flagged unproven latency as a blocking finding among four findings.
cases.expected_output: A delta pass that updates only the latency finding and the conclusion, keeping the same layout.

assertions.text: Unchanged findings are not re-rendered in full.
The latency finding and the conclusion reflect the new evidence.

pass: Only changed evidence, findings, and conclusion appear.
fail: The full report is repeated, or the new evidence is ignored.

cases.prompt: Review this pull request diff for bugs before I merge it.
cases.initial_state: The user supplies a code diff; no plan or proposal is under discussion.
cases.expected_output: The work is routed to internal-review-code instead of producing a critical analysis.

assertions.text: The response routes to internal-review-code or does not activate this skill.

forbidden_actions: Producing a Critical Analysis report for a code diff

pass: The code review owner handles the request.
fail: A lens-based critical analysis is returned for the diff.
